_howto: Every film on the site comes from this file, in the order listed. To add a film: put a 1080p .mp4 (and optionally a 720p one for phones) in /videos and two 16:9 poster JPGs in /assets/img named NAME-800.jpg and NAME-1600.jpg, set poster to /assets/img/NAME, add an entry below, then run: node tools/build.mjs. Set featured to true for up to three films to show them on the home page (the first featured film is shown largest). kind must be one of: client (made for a paying client), studio (made by Amble Films for its own brand), concept (a speculative film made to explore an idea), study (a short visual experiment). category must be one of: brand, product, advertising, explainer, education, concepts. services lists the service pages the film appears on as an example. Never list stock footage here: films on this page are Amble Films productions.
